summary: Deterministic plan-local identity projections for Quick Dev router; PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; slices=W0-W6; excludes logs/ and plan-state.v1.json/resume-state.v1.json; rejects absolute, parent-traversing, excluded, escaping, or symlink identity paths; hashes files with SHA-256 and canonical JSON with sorted keys/compact separators; loads and validates implementation contract plan_id plus slice list; candidate manifest derives allowed_changes and planned_new_files, normalizes tools paths under execution-plans/.../tools, deduplicates and sorts entries; dependency identities include dependency candidate hashes; current identity hashes candidate, predicate inputs, authority files, validator files, closure definition, and validator source; validator_version=toolchain-workflow-repair.validate-all.v1; exposes per-slice and aggregate validation snapshots; ambiguity: file absence is represented as absent state, while unreadable files raise errors.
